scope: Actual authenticated GitHub clone on Windows, fresh npm/browser installation, build/type/unit checks, local key configuration and the complete provider-disabled six-window lifecycle; separate cold Linux-container startup and queue checks.

clone.initialObservation: Immediately after the remote clone, explicit filesystem checks found no node_modules, .output, .nuxt, .env or .cache/ai-provider.xml. No files were copied from the original computer to satisfy those requirements.
clone.browsers: npx playwright install chromium firefox with PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH inside the clone; browser binaries were downloaded into that new directory.

stage.title: Pause verification
stage.detail: The next action waits until Resume.

stage.title: Open the shared recruitment cycle
stage.detail: One administrator sets the current semester and recruitment window for everyone.

stage.title: Define the course position
stage.detail: CS201 needs a TA for attendance, labs, grading and office hours.

stage.title: Set qualifications and publish for approval
stage.detail: The instructor defines the evidence applicants must supply; publication requires administrator approval.

stage.title: Approve the course opening
stage.detail: The administrator confirms the posting before students can apply.

stage.title: Discover the opportunity
stage.detail: Alex begins as an ordinary student, with no TA role or existing offer.

stage.title: Answer the qualification questions
stage.detail: Personal background, availability and technical answers remain private to the authorized reviewers.

stage.title: Attach a CV and submit
stage.detail: The submitted application records a stable version of the answers and private attachment.

stage.title: Apply to another course as well
stage.detail: Alex also applies to CS101, so the next selection will demonstrate coordination between two instructors.

stage.title: A second instructor reviews the same applicant
stage.detail: Before an offer, Alex is available to both courses. Neither instructor receives automatic hiring authority.

stage.title: Review Alex for CS201
stage.detail: The faculty reviewer can inspect the submitted profile, answers and private CV.

stage.title: Shortlist and issue the offer
stage.detail: The faculty decision reserves the candidate and position together.

stage.title: The other instructor sees availability update
stage.detail: Alex now has an overlapping offer. CS101 cannot select the same applicant again.

stage.title: Accept the CS201 offer
stage.detail: The candidate chooses. Acceptance alone does not grant TA course access.

stage.title: Record the appointment clearance
stage.detail: An administrator confirms clearance; no manual TA role grant is needed.

stage.title: Alex becomes the appointed course TA
stage.detail: The same account updates silently from pending clearance to Active and gains the CS201 queue link.

stage.title: Start the office-hours shift
stage.detail: Alex is on duty for CS201, with appointment-derived authority for this course only.

stage.title: The existing TA coordinates the session
stage.detail: A second TA sees the same live course and posts an announcement for students.

stage.title: A student enrolls in the course
stage.detail: Sam has a separate student session. The course requires enrollment before joining the queue.

stage.title: Ask for help through the live queue
stage.detail: Sam supplies a location and a concrete debugging question.

stage.title: Alex claims Sam’s request
stage.detail: The queue assigns one helper to this request; the student sees the same claim automatically.

stage.title: The student sees who is helping
stage.detail: Sam’s queue state updates without refreshing the page.

stage.title: Complete the help session
stage.detail: The completed session enters the course history. This is one synthetic help interaction, not a simulated semester.

stage.title: Give feedback on the support
stage.detail: Sam rates Alex's recorded help session. Personal feedback stays separate from general course feedback.

stage.title: Record work beyond queue timing
stage.detail: Alex reports office-hours work separately; queue duration does not represent all teaching work.

stage.title: Review course operations and feedback
stage.detail: The instructor sees the completed session and Sam’s feedback in the course management view.

stage.title: Close the course support queue
stage.detail: Course closeout clears remaining requests and duty. This is a queue closure, not calendar semester expiry.

stage.title: Return to the TA page before closeout
stage.detail: Keep the appointed TA’s page open so automatic access removal will be visible.

stage.title: End the appointment with a reason
stage.detail: The faculty member closes Alex’s appointment and its dated course authority ends.

stage.title: TA access disappears automatically
stage.detail: The same person returns to the student course view; no administrator manually removes a role.

stage.title: See the evidence for the next cycle
stage.detail: Course activity, reported work and staffing capacity inform the next support plan.

stage.title: Compare department demand and support
stage.detail: The administrator compares courses, busy hours and attributed feedback, with sample sizes and teaching workload visible.

stage.title: Archive the completed opening
stage.detail: The instructor archives this position after the appointment has ended.

stage.title: One account, a complete lifecycle
stage.detail: Alex retains the application and appointment history, with no remaining TA course authority. The next loop restores only this isolated demo.

keyConfiguration.scope: Clean GitHub clone local key configuration only; synthetic credential, no provider call.

browser.scope: Actual Chromium four-role queue lifecycle against the newly built Linux container and fresh authenticated replica-set volumes.

actualGitHubCloneBuild.boundary: Docker build from the actual clean GitHub clone, using normal layer caching. The separate tracked-only cold build and fresh-volume runtime checks are retained independently. PowerShell stderr-redirection status is not used as a Docker exit-code substitute.

healthGate.scope: A disposable standalone MongoDB must not satisfy the replica-set startup gate even though ping succeeds.

docker.boundary: The cold container used tracked application files from its recorded commit plus hashed current package/Compose/example-config overlays. The actual GitHub clone also built a Linux image with an explicitly recorded Docker exit code, using normal layer caching. Deployment-only substitutions selected isolated project/volume names and free loopback ports.

boundaries: The native lifecycle used the explicit no-AI mode and a newly generated application database. It did not test new OpenAI authentication or model quality. Key-only .env and new Windows-encrypted settings were checked with synthetic credentials, then removed; no real Key was copied or loaded.

The normal live launcher still requires the user to enter a valid Key on the new computer and obtain fresh OpenAI responses. Earlier real-provider receipts retain their own dates and source/script hashes.
Windows x64 and Linux Docker runtime behavior were exercised. No physical second computer, macOS desktop, ARM hardware or institutional SSO is claimed as tested.
Docker, a compatible Node version for the native presentation, browser system dependencies, a graphical desktop and required network access remain installation prerequisites.
Finite local tests and a clean clone do not establish universal correctness or remove provider/account/network constraints.
